qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Lacks a structural moat across the consolidated group ('None'). While Adhesive Technologies has industrial application stickiness, Consumer Brands (Persil, Schwarzkopf, Dial) faces persistent private-label erosion and weak volume growth. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 8.72% (well below the 12% threshold) burdened by heavy historical M&A goodwill, with organic sales growth driven by price increases against flat or negative volumes.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (3a = None, 3b = N, REJECT). German consumer goods and adhesives conglomerate whose 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 8.72% fails the 12% threshold. Consumer Brands unit chronically loses volume when attempting to pass on chemical and energy inflation, while accumulated M&A goodwill permanently depresses consolidated returns.
qualitative.evidence: Reported GAAP ROIC of 6.30% (FY22), 6.99% (FY23), 10.45% (FY24), and 10.72% (FY25) yields a 5-year median of 8.72%. Goodwill and intangibles of EUR 17.3B on EUR 20.5B equity. Organic volume growth was negative in 2023 (-4.2% price vs negative volume) and flat in 2025 (+0.9% organic entirely price-led).
